title: Enhance Docker Builder with BUILD_MODE and RUNTIME_MODE in Image Tagging
description: Implement centralized BUILD_MODE and RUNTIME_MODE handling in docker_builder.py generate_image_tag() method to resolve TODO on line 986 and improve cache differentiation
acceptance_criteria: BUILD_MODE and RUNTIME_MODE are properly reflected in Docker image tags
generate_image_tag() method handles both modes with proper fallbacks
service_manager_docker_mixin no longer handles image tag generation
Backward compatibility maintained for existing images
All tests pass with new tagging scheme
Cache differentiation works correctly for different mode combinations

implementation_phases.name: Core Enhancement
implementation_phases.description: Enhance generate_image_tag() method and update build_image()
tasks: Update build_image() to extract modes from config

implementation_phases.name: Integration Updates
implementation_phases.description: Remove split responsibility and update integration points
tasks: Remove image tag generation from service_manager_docker_mixin.py
Update Docker build call to use clean version
Update logging to use returned image tags

implementation_phases.name: Documentation
implementation_phases.description: Update documentation and create migration guide

files_to_modify.description: Remove local image tag generation logic

high_risk_areas: Cache invalidation - all existing images will need rebuilding
CI/CD impact - build pipelines may reference old tag patterns
Registry storage - temporary storage increase during transition
mitigation_strategies: Gradual rollout with feature flag for new tagging scheme
Parallel tags - generate both old and new tags during transition
Cleanup scripts - remove old images after validation

functional: All Docker builds generate tags with both BUILD_MODE and RUNTIME_MODE
No performance regression in build times
quality: Code coverage > 90% for new tag generation logic
No duplicate image tag generation logic
Proper error handling for invalid mode combinations

rollback_plan: Restore original tagging logic in service_manager_docker_mixin.py
